ch2_q23.doctrine: Pre-2001 Immovable Asset Capital Gain Computation Rules

root.title: Pre-2001 Asset Valuation & Forfeiture Rules
root.voice_sync_text: Welcome students! Today we are learning three critical statutory provisions for pre-2001 immovable assets: Section 55(2)(b) valuation ceiling, Section 51 advance forfeiture, and Section 55(1)(b) cost of improvement rules.

points.title: Substituted Cost & SDV Cap
body: Higher of actual cost of acquisition or Fair Market Value as on 1st April 2001.
Fair Market Value as on 1st April 2001 cannot exceed the Stamp Duty Value on that date.

highlights.phrase: Fair Market Value as on 1st April 2001
cannot exceed the Stamp Duty Value

points.voice_sync_text: 1st April 2001-ന് മുമ്പ് acquire ചെയ്ത capital asset ആണെങ്കിൽ, 1st April 2001-ലെ Fair Market Value അല്ലെങ്കിൽ actual Cost of Acquisition, ഇതിൽ ഏതാണോ higher, അതാണ് Cost of Acquisition ആയി എടുക്കുന്നത്. എന്നാൽ immovable property ആണെങ്കിൽ, ഈ Fair Market Value എന്നത് 1st April 2001-ലെ Stamp Duty Value-യിൽ കൂടാൻ പാടില്ല.

points.title: Pre-2014 vs Post-2014 Forfeiture
body: Advance money forfeited prior to 1st April 2014 is deducted from the Cost of Acquisition.
Advance money forfeited on or after 1st April 2014 is taxable as Income from Other Sources.

highlights.phrase: deducted from the Cost of Acquisition
taxable as Income from Other Sources

points.voice_sync_text: Advance money forfeit ചെയ്യുമ്പോൾ date വളരെ critical ആണ്. 1st April 2014-ന് മുമ്പാണ് advance money forfeit ചെയ്തതെങ്കിൽ, Section 51 പ്രകാരം അത് Cost of Acquisition-ൽ നിന്ന് deduct ചെയ്യണം. എന്നാൽ 1st April 2014-ലോ ശേഷമോ ആണ് forfeiture എങ്കിൽ, Section 56(2)(ix) പ്രകാരം Income from Other Sources ആയി അത് full tax ചെയ്യപ്പെടും.

points.title: Pre-2001 Improvement Expenses
body: Any cost of improvement incurred before 1st April 2001 is completely ignored.
Only cost of improvement incurred on or after 1st April 2001 is eligible for deduction.
points.voice_sync_text: 1st April 2001-ന് മുമ്പ് ചെലവഴിച്ച ഏത് Cost of Improvement-ഉം tax computation-ൽ പൂർണ്ണമായും ignore ചെയ്യണം. കാരണം 1st April 2001-ലെ Fair Market Value എടുക്കുമ്പോൾ ഈ improvement-ന്റെ value കൂടി പ്രതിഫലിക്കുന്നുണ്ട്.

concept_simulation.doctrine_topic: Statutory Cost Determination for Pre-2001 Immovable Asset
statutory_assumptions: Asset acquired in FY 1995-96 for ₹ 10,00,000
Advance forfeited in FY 2008-09 = ₹ 2,00,000
Improvement spent in FY 1998-99 = ₹ 3,00,000
concept_simulation.intro_voice: ഇനി ഈ statutory rules എങ്ങനെയെന്ന് ഒരു simple numerical example വഴി മനസ്സിലാക്കാം.

steps.title: Pre-2001 Acquisition & Improvement Cost
steps.voice_sync_text: ഇവിടെ asset 1st April 2001-ന് മുമ്പ് ₹ 10,00,000-ന് വങ്ങി. 1st April 2001-ന് മുമ്പ് ചെയ്ത ₹ 3,00,000-ന്റെ Cost of Improvement പ്രൊവിഷൻ അനുസരിച്ച് ignore ചെയ്യപ്പെടും.
steps.image_prompt: A 16:9 cinematic 2.5D isometric view of a real estate property purchase contract deed signed in 1995, golden lighting, financial graphics.

steps.title: Valuation Ceiling Application (FMV vs SDV)
steps.voice_sync_text: 1st April 2001-ൽ FMV ₹ 20,00,000 ആയിരുന്നെങ്കിലും, Section 55(2)(b) proviso പ്രകാരം അത് Stamp Duty Value ആയ ₹ 15,00,000-ൽ പരിമിതപ്പെടുത്തുന്നു.
steps.image_prompt: A 16:9 isometric financial diagram showing two balance scales: Fair Market Value capped sharply by a legal Stamp Duty Value seal, glowing blue overhead light.

steps.title: Substituted Cost Comparison
steps.metric_label: Higher of Actual Cost or Capped FMV
steps.voice_sync_text: Actual cost ₹ 10,00,000-ഉം capped FMV ₹ 15,00,000-ഉം തമ്മിൽ compare ചെയ്യുമ്പോൾ, higher തുകയായ ₹ 15,00,000 എടുക്കുന്നു.
steps.image_prompt: A 16:9 2.5D isometric comparative digital bar chart highlighting actual purchase cost versus capped stamp duty fair market value, high technology display.

steps.title: Pre-2014 Advance Money Forfeiture Deduction
steps.voice_sync_text: 1st April 2014-ന് മുമ്പ് forfeit ചെയ്ത ₹ 2,00,000 advance money Section 51 പ്രകാരം Cost-ൽ നിന്ന് minus ചെയ്യുന്നു. അങ്ങനെ Final Cost ₹ 13,00,000 ആകുന്നു.
steps.image_prompt: A 16:9 isometric legal accounting breakdown showing ₹ 2,00,000 advance money deduction from ₹ 15,00,000 base cost, sharp focus studio light.

calculation_data.formula: Final Cost = Min(FMV, SDV) - Advance Forfeited Before 01.04.2014

ch2_q24.doctrine: Cost Determination for Gifted Assets & Advance Money Provisions

root.title: Gifted Assets & Pre-2001 Cost Rules
root.voice_sync_text: Welcome! Today we are studying the statutory rules for computing Capital Gains on gifted assets acquired prior to 1st April 2001, focusing on Section 49(1), Section 55(2)(b), and Section 51.

points.title: Cost & Period of Holding of Previous Owner
body: Where a Capital Asset becomes the property of the assessee under a Gift, Will, or Inheritance, the Cost of Acquisition of the asset shall be deemed to be the cost for which the Previous Owner acquired it.
Under Section 2(42A), the Period of Holding of the Previous Owner is aggregated with the holding period of the assessee to determine whether the asset is a Long-term Capital Asset.

highlights.phrase: Period of Holding of the Previous Owner

points.voice_sync_text: Section 49(1) അനുസരിച്ച് Gift വഴി ഒരു Capital Asset ലഭിക്കുകയാണെങ്കിൽ, Previous Owner അത് വാങ്ങിയ തുകയാണ് assessee-യുടെ Cost of Acquisition ആയി കണക്കാക്കുന്നത്. അതുപോലെ Section 2(42A) പ്രകാരം asset Long-term Capital Asset ആണോ എന്ന് തീരുമാനിക്കാൻ Previous Owner-ന്റെ Period of Holding കൂടി ചേർക്കണം.

points.title: Option of FMV & Stamp Duty Value Cap
body: For assets acquired prior to 1st April 2001, the assessee can opt for the Fair Market Value as on 1st April 2001 in lieu of actual cost.
As per the Proviso to Section 55(2)(b), the Fair Market Value as on 1st April 2001 cannot exceed the Stamp Duty Value as on 1st April 2001.

highlights.phrase: cannot exceed the Stamp Duty Value
Fair Market Value as on 1st April 2001

rows: Capped at Stamp Duty Value as on 01.04.2001
Higher of Actual Cost OR Capped FMV

points.voice_sync_text: Section 55(2)(b) പ്രകാരം 1st April 2001-ന് മുമ്പ് വാങ്ങിയ asset ആണെങ്കിൽ, 1st April 2001-ലെ Fair Market Value എടുക്കാൻ option ഉണ്ട്. പക്ഷെ Proviso to Section 55(2)(b) അനുസരിച്ച് ഈ Fair Market Value as on 1st April 2001 ഒരിക്കലും Stamp Duty Value-യെക്കാൾ കൂടാൻ പാടില്ല.

points.title: Treatment of Advance Money Forfeited
body: Advance Money forfeited prior to 1st April 2014 by the assessee is deducted from the Cost of Acquisition under Section 51.
Advance Money forfeited by the Previous Owner is NOT deducted from the Cost of Acquisition in the hands of the current owner/donee.

highlights.phrase: deducted from the Cost of Acquisition
NOT deducted from the Cost of Acquisition

points.voice_sync_text: ഇവിടെ എക്സാമിൽ വരാവുന്ന പ്രധാനപ്പെട്ട ഒരു trap ഉണ്ട്. Section 51 പ്രകാരം 1st April 2014-ന് മുമ്പ് Advance Money forfeit ചെയ്തത് assessee തന്നെയാണെങ്കിൽ മാത്രമേ Cost of Acquisition-ൽ നിന്ന് deduct ചെയ്യൂ. അത് Previous Owner ആണ് forfeit ചെയ്തതെങ്കിൽ current owner-ന്റെ Cost of Acquisition-ൽ നിന്ന് deduct ചെയ്യാൻ പാടില്ല.

points.title: Aggregation of Improvement Expenses
body: Cost of Improvement includes any capital expenditure incurred by the Previous Owner or the assessee after 1st April 2001.
Expenditure incurred prior to 1st April 2001 is completely ignored when substituting Fair Market Value as on 1st April 2001.

highlights.phrase: incurred by the Previous Owner or the assessee

points.voice_sync_text: Section 55(1)(b) അനുസരിച്ച് Cost of Improvement കണക്കാക്കുമ്പോൾ 1st April 2001-ന് ശേഷം Previous Owner ഓ assessee ഓ നടത്തുന്ന capital expenditure കൂട്ടാം. എന്നാൽ 1st April 2001-ന് മുമ്പ് നടത്തിയ improvement ചിലവുകൾ പൂർണ്ണമായും ignore ചെയ്യണം.

concept_simulation.doctrine_topic: Cost Determination for Gifted Asset with Pre-2001 Purchase and Advance Forfeiture
statutory_assumptions: Asset original acquisition prior to 1st April 2001 by Previous Owner at ₹ 1,00,000
Fair Market Value as on 01.04.2001 is ₹ 4,00,000 but Stamp Duty Value is ₹ 3,00,000
Previous owner forfeited advance money of ₹ 50,000 in 2004
Previous owner incurred Cost of Improvement of ₹ 2,00,000 in 2008 and gifted it thereafter
concept_simulation.intro_voice: നമുക്ക് ഈ statutory rules ഒരു practical scenario വഴി വ്യക്തമായി കണ്ടു മനസ്സിലാക്കാം.

steps.title: Original Acquisition & Pre-2001 Valuation
steps.voice_sync_text: Previous Owner asset പണ്ടേ വാങ്ങിയിരിക്കുന്നു. 1st April 2001-ൽ ഇതിന്റെ Fair Market Value ₹ 4 Lakhs ആണെങ്കിലും Stamp Duty Value ₹ 3 Lakhs മാത്രമാണ്.
steps.image_prompt: Cinematic 2.5D isometric view of an elegant residential villa standing in 2001, showing an architectural blueprint overlay displaying purchase cost of ₹1 Lakh and valuation charts comparing Fair Market Value versus Stamp Duty Value.

steps.title: Application of Proviso to Section 55(2)(b)
steps.voice_sync_text: Proviso to Section 55(2)(b) പ്രകാരം 1st April 2001-ലെ Fair Market Value, Stamp Duty Value ആയ ₹ 3 Lakhs-ൽ പരിമിതപ്പെടുത്തുന്നു. So Cost of Acquisition becomes higher of ₹ 1 Lakh or ₹ 3 Lakhs, which is ₹ 3 Lakhs.
steps.image_prompt: Cinematic 2.5D isometric representation of a legal scale, balancing actual cost of ₹1 Lakh against Fair Market Value, with a digital red shield capping the valuation at Stamp Duty Value of ₹3 Lakhs.

steps.title: Treatment of Advance Money Forfeited by Previous Owner
steps.voice_sync_text: Previous owner 2004-ൽ ₹ 50,000 advance money forfeit ചെയ്തിരുന്നു. എന്നാൽ Section 51 പ്രകാരം Previous Owner forfeit ചെയ്ത തുക donee-യുടെ Cost of Acquisition-ൽ നിന്ന് കുറയ്ക്കാൻ പാടില്ല. So Cost remains ₹ 3 Lakhs.
steps.image_prompt: Cinematic 2.5D isometric visual of financial documents showing an advance deposit receipt stamped FORFEITED BY PREVIOUS OWNER with a green legal checkmark confirming zero deduction from asset base cost.

steps.title: Cost of Improvement & Final Capital Gains
steps.voice_sync_text: 2008-ൽ Previous Owner നടത്തിയ ₹ 2 Lakhs-ന്റെ Cost of Improvement കൂട്ടിയാൽ Total Cost ₹ 5 Lakhs ആകുന്നു. Asset ₹ 10 Lakhs-ന് വിക്കുമ്പോൾ Taxable Long-term Capital Gain ₹ 5 Lakhs ലഭിക്കും.
steps.image_prompt: Cinematic 2.5D isometric scene of a renovated floor addition on top of the residential property, transitioning into a digital tax computation dashboard showing Sale Price ₹10 Lakhs minus Total Cost ₹5 Lakhs.

rows: Less: Cost of Acquisition (Higher of Cost or SDV Cap)

ch2_q25.doctrine: Section 54 Exemption & Section 51 Advance Money Forfeiture Framework

root.title: Capital Gains Exemption & Forfeiture Rules
root.voice_sync_text: Welcome! ഇൻകം ടാക്സ് ആക്ടിലെ Section 51 പ്രകാരമുള്ള Advance Money Forfeiture, Section 54 Capital Gains Exemption എന്നിവയുടെ Statutory Provisions നമുക്ക് പരിശോധിക്കാം.

points.title: Pre-2014 vs Post-2014 Forfeiture Mechanism
body: Advance money received and forfeited prior to 1st April 2014 is deducted from the Cost of Acquisition.
Advance money forfeited on or after 1st April 2014 is taxed under Income from Other Sources u/s 56(2)(ix).

highlights.phrase: prior to 1st April 2014 is deducted from the Cost of Acquisition

rows: Taxable as Income from Other Sources

points.voice_sync_text: ഇവിടെ Capital Asset വിൽക്കാൻ കരാറിലേർപ്പെട്ട് Advance തുക Forfeit ചെയ്താൽ രണ്ട് തരം tax treatment ആണുള്ളത്. 1st April 2014-ന് മുൻപാണ് Advance Money Forfeit ചെയ്തതെങ്കിൽ, Section 51 പ്രകാരം Cost of Acquisition-ൽ നിന്ന് ആ തുക deduct ചെയ്യണം. എന്നാൽ 1st April 2014-ന് ശേഷമാണ് Forfeiture എങ്കിൽ Section 56(2)(ix) പ്രകാരം Income from Other Sources ആയി ടാക്സ് ചെയ്യപ്പെടും.

points.title: Eligible Timelines for Reinvestment
body: Purchase of new residential house must be within 1 year before or 2 years after the date of transfer.
Construction of residential house property must be completed within 3 years after the date of transfer.

highlights.phrase: within 3 years after the date of transfer

points.voice_sync_text: Section 54 Exemption ലഭിക്കണമെങ്കിൽ, transfer ഡേറ്റിന് 1 year before അല്ലെങ്കിൽ 2 years after ഉള്ളിൽ പുതിയ residential house purchase ചെയ്തിരിക്കണം. അല്ലെങ്കിൽ transfer കഴിഞ്ഞ് 3 years-നുള്ളിൽ പുതിയ വീടിന്റെ construction പൂർത്തിയാക്കേണ്ടതുണ്ട്.

points.title: Doctrine of Beneficial Ownership
body: Registration of legal title is not mandatory to claim Section 54 exemption if full consideration is paid.
Taking possession under an agreement to sell satisfies the criteria of purchasing residential property.

highlights.phrase: Registration of legal title is not mandatory

points.voice_sync_text: Section 54 Exemption അവകാശപ്പെടാൻ Assessee-ക്ക് legal title registration അനിവാര്യമാണോ? അല്ല! Balraj v. CIT കേസിൽ Apex Bench വ്യക്തമാക്കുന്നത്, full consideration നൽകുകയും Possession ഏറ്റെടുക്കുകയും ചെയ്തിട്ടുണ്ടെങ്കിൽ, formal conveyance deed registered അല്ലെങ്കിലും Section 54 Exemption അനുവദനീയമാണ്.

points.title: Two Houses Exemption Threshold Rule
body: If Long-Term Capital Gains do not exceed ₹ 2 Crore, exemption is allowed for two residential houses in India.
This statutory concession for two house properties can be claimed once in a lifetime by the assessee.
points.voice_sync_text: Section 54 പ്രകാരം പൊതുവേ ഒരു Residential House-ൽ മാത്രമേ Exemption ലഭിക്കൂ. എന്നാൽ Assessee-യുടെ Long-Term Capital Gain തുക ₹ 2 Crore കവിയുന്നില്ലെങ്കിൽ, ഇന്ത്യയിലുള്ള TWO residential houses-ൽ നടത്തുന്ന Investment-ന് Exemption അവകാശപ്പെടാം. ഈ ആനുകൂല്യം ജീവിതത്തിൽ ഒരിക്കൽ മാത്രമേ നേടാൻ സാധിക്കൂ.

concept_simulation.doctrine_topic: Section 51 Cost Adjustment & Section 54 Dual House Exemption
statutory_assumptions: Illustrative Purchase Cost: ₹ 10,00,000 in 2003 with ₹ 1,00,000 advance forfeited prior to 1st April 2014.
Illustrative Sale Consideration: ₹ 50,00,000 resulting in LTCG ≤ ₹ 2 Crore eligible for dual house exemption.
concept_simulation.intro_voice: ഇനി ഈ പ്രൊവിഷനുകൾ ഒരു റിയൽ-ലൈഫ് ഇല്ലസ്ട്രേറ്റീവ് എക്സാമ്പിളിലൂടെ കണ്ടു മനസ്സിലാക്കാം.

steps.title: Pre-2014 Advance Forfeiture & Net Cost Determination
steps.voice_sync_text: ഒരു Capital Asset 2003-ൽ ₹ 10 Lakhs-ന് വാങ്ങുകയും, 2008-ൽ ₹ 1 Lakh Advance വാങ്ങിയ ശേഷം 계약 മുടങ്ങിയപ്പോൾ Forfeit ചെയ്യുകയും ചെയ്തു. Section 51 അനുസരിച്ച്, Pre-2014 Forfeiture ആയതിനാൽ Purchase Cost-ൽ നിന്ന് ₹ 1 Lakh കുറച്ച് Net Cost ₹ 9 Lakhs ആയി ക്രമീകരിക്കുന്നു.
steps.image_prompt: A modern 2.5D isometric illustration showing a legal property contract on a desk, with green money icons being deducted from a valuation ledger sheet, sharp realistic studio lighting, clean office backdrop.

steps.title: Transfer of Asset & LTCG Computation
steps.voice_sync_text: ഈ Property ₹ 50 Lakhs-ന് വിൽക്കുമ്പോൾ Adjusted Cost ആയ ₹ 9 Lakhs കഴിച്ചുള്ള തുക Long-Term Capital Gain ആയി വരുന്നു. Gain ₹ 2 Crore-ൽ കുറവായതിനാൽ Section 54 Proviso അപ്ലൈ ചെയ്യാം.
steps.image_prompt: A 2.5D isometric view of a residential bungalow with a sold sign in front, glowing digital calculator showing net capital gains breakdown floating beside it, photorealistic cinematic lighting.

steps.title: Investment in Two Residential Houses
steps.voice_sync_text: LTCG ₹ 2 Crore-ൽ താഴെയായതിനാൽ, വിറ്റ തുക ഉപയോഗിച്ച് ₹ 12 Lakhs-ന് ഒരു വീടും ₹ 8 Lakhs-ന് മറ്റൊരു വീടും വാങ്ങുന്നു. രണ്ടിനും കൂട്ടി ₹ 20 Lakhs Exemption സെക്ഷൻ 54 പ്രകാരം അനുവദനീയമാണ്.
steps.image_prompt: A 2.5D architectural visualization displaying two distinct elegant residential villas side by side with glowing green checkmarks above them, blueprint background, golden cinematic glow.

slides.title: Forfeiture of Advance Money: Sec 51 vs Sec 56(2)(ix)
slides.subtitle: Cut-off Date: 1st April 2014
slides.voice_sync_text: Forfeited Advance Money-യുടെ Tax treatment തീരുമാനിക്കുന്നത് ആ തുക എപ്പോഴാണ് Forfeit ചെയ്തത് എന്നതിന്റെ അടിസ്ഥാനത്തിലാണ്.

cards.heading: Forfeited Before 01-04-2014 (Sec 51)
points: Deducted directly from the Cost of Acquisition of the capital asset.
Reduces the base cost before applying indexation.

cards.heading: Forfeited On or After 01-04-2014 (Sec 56(2)(ix))
points: Taxed as revenue income under Income from Other Sources.
No reduction made to the Cost of Acquisition.

slides.title: Section 54: Title Ownership & Two Houses Exception
slides.subtitle: Judicial Precedents & Proviso Thresholds
slides.voice_sync_text: legal title registration ഇല്ലെങ്കിലും full payment ചെയ്താൽ Section 54 ലഭിക്കും. കൂടാതെ capital gain 2 Crore രൂപയ്ക്ക് താഴെയാണെങ്കിൽ 2 വീടുകൾക്ക് വരെ exemption ലഭിക്കും.

cards.heading: Beneficial Ownership Standard
points: Full consideration paid and possession taken under agreement is sufficient.
Execution of registered sale deed is NOT mandatory (*Balraj v. CIT*).

cards.heading: Two Residential Houses Option
points: Applicable only if aggregate LTCG does not exceed ₹ 2 Crore.
Can be exercised by an assessee only ONCE in a lifetime.

beats.voice_sync_text: 1st April 2014-ന് മുൻപ് Forfeit ചെയ്ത Advance Money, Asset-ന്റെ Cost of Acquisition-ൽ നിന്ന് കുറയ്ക്കുന്നു.

ch2_q26.doctrine: Section 54 Exemption & Integrated Residential Unit Doctrine

root.title: Section 54: Integrated Unit Doctrine
root.badge: Section 54 · CIT v. D. Ananda Basappa
root.voice_sync_text: Section 54 പ്രകാരം Long-term Capital Gain Claim ചെയ്യുമ്പോൾ adjacent flats വാങ്ങി single unit ആയി മാറ്റിയാൽ exemption ലഭിക്കുമോ എന്ന് നമുക്ക് പരിശോധിക്കാം.

points.title: Eligibility & Reinvestment Timelines
body: Transfer of a Long-term Capital Asset being a residential house property.
Purchase of new residential house within 1 year before or 2 years after transfer, or construction within 3 years.

highlights.phrase: within 1 year before or 2 years after

points.voice_sync_text: Section 54(1) പ്രകാരം long-term residential house property transfer ചെയ്യുമ്പോൾ 1 year before അല്ലെങ്കിൽ 2 years after purchase നടത്തണം, അല്ലെങ്കിൽ 3 years-നുള്ളിൽ construction പൂർത്തിയാക്കണം.

points.title: Monetary Restriction & Statutory Threshold
body: If Long-term Capital Gain exceeds ₹ 2 Crore, exemption is strictly restricted to one residential house in India.
Maximum exemption under Section 54 is capped at ₹ 10 Crore w.e.f. A.Y. 2024-25.
points.voice_sync_text: Long-term Capital Gain 2 Crore രൂപയിൽ കൂടുതൽ ആണെങ്കിൽ exemption ഒരു residential house-ലേക്ക് മാത്രമായി restrict ചെയ്യപ്പെടും.

points.title: Physical Integration & Intention Test
body: Purchase of contiguous or adjacent flats modified into a single integrated residential unit qualifies as one residential house.
Architect or builder certification of structural modification establishes single unit status.

highlights.phrase: modified into a single integrated residential unit

points.voice_sync_text: adjacent flats വാങ്ങി physical modifications വഴി single unit ആക്കി മാറ്റിയാൽ, അത് നിയമപരമായി one residential house ആയി തന്നെ പരിഗണിക്കും എന്ന് CIT v. D. Ananda Basappa കേസിൽ കർണാടക ഹൈക്കോടതി വിധിച്ചിട്ടുണ്ട്.

points.title: Irrelevance of Deeds and Prior Occupation
body: Purchase via separate sale deeds from different sellers does not disentitle exemption under Section 54.
Occupation of flats by different tenants prior to acquisition is irrelevant if converted into one unit post-acquisition.

highlights.phrase: does not disentitle exemption under Section 54

points.voice_sync_text: വ്യത്യസ്ത sale deeds വഴി വാങ്ങിയതുകൊണ്ടോ, പർച്ചേസിന് മുൻപ് വേറെ tenants താമസിച്ചിരുന്നു എന്നതുകൊണ്ടോ Section 54 exemption നിഷേധിക്കാൻ Assessing Officer-ക്ക് സാധിക്കില്ല.

concept_simulation.doctrine_topic: Section 54: Exemption for Integrated Residential Units
statutory_assumptions: Assessee derives Long-term Capital Gain exceeding ₹ 2 Crore from sale of residential house.
Purchases 2 contiguous adjacent flats and effects structural integration into 1 single residential apartment unit.
concept_simulation.intro_voice: നമുക്ക് ഈ നിയമതത്വം ഒരു simple numerical illustration വഴി കണ്ടു മനസ്സിലാക്കാം.

steps.voice_sync_text: ആദ്യമായി, ഒരു Assessee residential house വിറ്റ് 3 Crore രൂപ Long-term Capital Gain ഉണ്ടാക്കുന്നു.
steps.image_prompt: A modern luxury residential tower in a metropolitan Indian city with a sold tag displayed outside, 2.5D architectural isometric style, subtle golden ambient sunlight, clean professional 3D render.

steps.title: Acquisition of Two Adjacent Units
steps.voice_sync_text: Assessee തൊട്ടടുത്ത് കിടക്കുന്ന രണ്ട് flats രണ്ട് വെവ്വേറെ sale deeds വഴി ആകെ 2.5 Crore രൂപയ്ക്ക് വാങ്ങുന്നു.
steps.image_prompt: Isometric cutaway diagram showing two side-by-side apartment units on the same floor of a high-rise building, clear interior walls dividing them, 2.5D architectural isometric vector style.

steps.image_prompt: Isometric 3D render of the same two apartments, with the central dividing wall removed and an elegant open doorway interconnecting them into a single spacious flat, architectural blueprint overlay.

steps.title: Section 54 Exemption Assessment
steps.voice_sync_text: ഇത് legally one residential house ആയതിനാൽ, 2.5 Crore രൂപയുടെ മുഴുവൻ നിക്ഷേപത്തിനും Section 54 exemption അനുവദനീയമാണ്.
steps.image_prompt: A clean financial tax computation dashboard displaying full approval of Section 54 exemption, green compliance checkmarks, isometric 3D visual style.

root.title: Compulsory Acquisition & Section 54D
root.voice_sync_text: Welcome students. Today, we are analyzing the statutory mechanism of compulsory acquisition under Section 45(5) and the exemption benefit available for industrial undertakings under Section 54D.

points.title: Year of Taxability
body: Capital gains arise in the year of compulsory acquisition transfer.
Taxability is deferred to the year in which initial compensation is received.
points.voice_sync_text: Section 45(5) പ്രകാരം compulsory acquisition transfer നടക്കുമ്പോൾ taxable capital gain arise ചെയ്യുമെങ്കിലും, tax liability വരുന്നത് actual initial compensation is received ചെയ്യുന്ന Financial Year-ൽ ആയിരിക്കും.

points.title: Prior Use & Investment Window
body: Asset must be land or building used for industrial undertaking for at least 2 years prior to transfer.
Reinvestment must be made within 3 years after transfer date in industrial land or building.

highlights.phrase: at least 2 years prior to transfer

points.voice_sync_text: Section 54D exemption ലഭിക്കണമെങ്കിൽ, compulsorily acquired asset industrial undertaking-നു വേണ്ടി at least 2 years prior to transfer ഉപയോഗിച്ചിരിക്കണം. Transfer date-ൽ നിന്ന് within 3 years after transfer date പുതിയ industrial asset purchase ചെയ്തിരിക്കണം.

points.title: Exemption & Lock-in Consequence
body: Exemption equals lower of capital gains or cost of new asset.
If new asset is transferred within 3 years, cost of acquisition is reduced by exempted gain.

highlights.phrase: lower of capital gains or cost of new asset

points.voice_sync_text: Section 54D പ്രകാരമുള്ള deduction എന്നത് lower of capital gains or cost of new asset ആയിരിക്കും. ഇനി ഈ പുതിയ asset 3 years-നുള്ളിൽ transfer ചെയ്താൽ, അതിന്റെ cost of acquisition is reduced by the earlier exempted capital gain.

statutory_assumptions: Industrial land acquired 5 years prior and used continuously for industrial undertaking.
Compulsory acquisition by government with statutory compensation received in full.
New industrial land purchased within the prescribed 3-year statutory window.
concept_simulation.intro_voice: ഇനി ഈ statutory rule എങ്ങനെയാണ് ഒരു practical computation-ൽ apply ചെയ്യുന്നതെന്ന് ഒരു simple visual example വഴി നോക്കാം.

steps.title: Industrial Land Acquisition & 2-Year Usage
steps.voice_sync_text: ഒരു assessee ₹ 5,00,000 രൂപയ്ക്ക് ഒരു industrial land വാങ്ങുകയും, continuous ആയി 2 years-ൽ കൂടുതൽ industrial undertaking-ന് ഉപയോഗിക്കുകയും ചെയ്യുന്നു.
steps.image_prompt: An industrial plot with a working factory setup, subtle blue isometric lighting showing a legal ownership deed floating above, dramatic 2.5D visual style.

steps.title: Compulsory Acquisition & Compensation
steps.voice_sync_text: Government ഈ land compulsorily acquire ചെയ്യുകയും, ₹ 20,00,000 compensation പൂർണ്ണമായും 지급 ചെയ്യുകയും ചെയ്യുന്നു. Section 45(5) പ്രകാരം taxability receipt year-ൽ വരുന്നു.
steps.image_prompt: Government acquisition seal overlaid on the industrial factory plot, glowing legal notification board with ₹ 20,00,000 compensation text, cinematic isometric perspective.

steps.title: Reinvestment in New Industrial Asset
steps.voice_sync_text: Assessee 3 years window-നുള്ളിൽ പുതിയ industrial land ₹ 12,00,000 രൂപയ്ക്ക് purchase ചെയ്യുന്നു. ഇത് Section 54D പ്രകാരം exemption-ന് eligible ആണ്.
steps.image_prompt: A brand new vacant industrial plot with modern architectural blueprints floating over it, highlighting reinvestment, golden isometric lighting.

steps.title: Net Taxable Capital Gain Computation
steps.voice_sync_text: Total Capital Gain ₹ 15,00,000-ൽ നിന്ന് new asset cost ആയ ₹ 12,00,000 Section 54D exemption ആയി subtract ചെയ്യുമ്പോൾ Net Taxable Capital Gain ₹ 3,00,000 ആയി ലഭിക്കുന്നു.
steps.image_prompt: A modern digital ledger displaying the computation breakdown with high tech glowing blue numbers and a final green stamp saying TAXABLE CAPITAL GAIN.

calculation_data.formula: Compensation Received - Cost of Acquisition - Section 54D Exemption

root.title: Section 54F Exemption Scheme
root.voice_sync_text: Welcome! Today we are analyzing Section 54F capital gains exemption on long term capital assets other than a residential house.

points.title: Eligible Assessee & Asset Type
body: The original asset transferred must be a long-term capital asset other than a residential house.
The assessee must be an Individual or HUF acquiring a residential house in India.
points.voice_sync_text: Section 54F claim ചെയ്യണമെങ്കിൽ assessee ഒരു Individual അല്ലെങ്കിൽ HUF ആയിരിക്കണം. Transfer ചെയ്തത് residential house ഒഴികെയുള്ള ഏതൊരു long-term capital asset ഉം ആവാം.

points.title: Computation of Exemption
body: If cost of new residential house equals or exceeds Net Consideration, the entire Capital Gain is exempt.
If cost of new house is less than Net Consideration, exempt amount is Proportional Capital Gain.
points.voice_sync_text: Net Consideration മുഴുവനായും new house ലെ reinvest ചെയ്താൽ entire Capital Gain is exempt. എന്നാൽ partial investment ആണെങ്കിൽ Proportional Capital Gain മാത്രമേ exempt ആകൂ.

points.title: Acquisition Timelines & CGAS Deposit
body: Acquisition must occur within 1 year before or 2 years after the date of transfer.
Construction of the residential house must be completed within 3 years from the date of transfer.
points.voice_sync_text: New house purchase ചെയ്യാൻ transfer-ന് 1 year before അല്ലെങ്കിൽ 2 years after സമയം ലഭിക്കും. Construction ആണെങ്കിൽ date of transfer-ൽ നിന്ന് 3 years ഉള്ളിൽ complete ചെയ്യണം.

points.title: Disqualification Conditions
body: Assessee must not own more than one residential house on the date of transfer.
Exemption is revoked if a second residential house is purchased within 2 years or constructed within 3 years.
points.voice_sync_text: Date of transfer-ൽ assessee-ക്ക് ഒന്നിൽ കൂടുതൽ residential house സ്വന്തമായി ഉണ്ടാകാൻ പാടില്ല. കൂടാതെ additional house വാങ്ങിയാൽ നേരത്തെ നൽകിയ exemption is revoked.

statutory_assumptions: Assessee transfers jewellery (Long-Term Capital Asset) during PY 2025-26.
Net Consideration after deducting transfer expenses is ₹ 20,00,000.
Computed Long-Term Capital Gain before exemption is ₹ 10,00,000.
concept_simulation.intro_voice: ഇനി Section 54F exemption-ന്റെ mathematical working ഒരു simple illustration വഴി കാണാം.

steps.title: Transfer of Long-Term Capital Asset
steps.voice_sync_text: ആദ്യമായി, Long-Term Capital Asset വിറ്റ ശേഷം transfer expenses കുറച്ചുള്ള Net Consideration ₹ 20,00,000 ആണ് എന്ന് കരുതുക.
steps.image_prompt: A modern luxury jewellery box showcasing gold ornaments on a velvet cushion next to legal tax computation papers on a polished wooden desk, cinematic 2.5D isometric view, studio lighting.

steps.title: Computation of Long-Term Capital Gain
steps.voice_sync_text: Net Consideration-ൽ നിന്ന് cost minus ചെയ്യുമ്പോൾ നമുക്ക് ലഭിക്കുന്ന Long-Term Capital Gain ₹ 10,00,000 ആണ്.
steps.image_prompt: A financial dashboard showing capital gain computation with tax icons and financial balance sheet, clean isometric 3D visual, blueprint blue background.

steps.title: Investment in Residential House
steps.voice_sync_text: ഇനി assessee ₹ 10,00,000 ചിലവഴിച്ച് ഒരു പുതിയ Residential House വാങ്ങുന്നു. ഇവിടെ investment, Net Consideration-നേക്കാൾ കുറവാണ്.
steps.image_prompt: An architect model of a contemporary single-family residential house with a green lawn, vibrant isometric style, soft architectural lighting.

steps.title: Proportional Exemption & Taxable LTCG
steps.voice_sync_text: Section 54F പ്രകാരം Exempt LTCG = ₹ 10 Lakhs into ₹ 10 Lakhs by ₹ 20 Lakhs, അതായത് ₹ 5,00,000. ബാക്കി ₹ 5,00,000 Taxable LTCG ആകുന്നു.
steps.image_prompt: A digital calculator screen showing the formula breakdown with checkmarks and tax exemption seal, high contrast isometric vector render.

calculation_data.formula: Taxable LTCG = Total LTCG - [LTCG × (Cost of New House / Net Consideration)]

ch2_q29.doctrine: Capital Gains: Valuation Rules, Pre-2001 Cost Ceiling & Section 54 Cap

root.title: Capital Gains: Valuation Rules & Section 54 Statutory Cap
root.voice_sync_text: നമസ്കാരം, ഇന്ന് നമ്മൾ പഠിക്കുന്നത് Capital Gains Head-ലെ മൂന്ന് പ്രധാനപ്പെട്ട statutory rules ആണ്: Section 50C tolerance limit, Section 55(2)(b) pre-2001 cost valuation rule, കൂടാതെ Section 54 exemption statutory ceiling limit.

branches.branch_title: Section 50C: Stamp Duty Valuation & Tolerance Band

points.title: 110% Safe Harbor Tolerance Rule
body: If Stamp Duty Value does not exceed 110% of actual consideration, actual consideration is taken as Full Value of Consideration.
If Stamp Duty Value exceeds 110% of actual consideration, Stamp Duty Value becomes Full Value of Consideration.
points.voice_sync_text: Section 50C അനുസരിച്ച്, transfer ചെയ്യുമ്പോൾ statutory authority നിശ്ചയിച്ച Stamp Duty Value, actual consideration-ന്റെ 110% വരെ ആണെങ്കിൽ, actual consideration തന്നെയാണ് Full Value of Consideration ആയി എടുക്കുക. 110% കവിഞ്ഞാൽ മാത്രമേ Stamp Duty Value ഫുൾ കൺസിഡറേഷനായി എടുക്കേണ്ടതുള്ളൂ.

points.title: FMV Restriction to 01.04.2001 Stamp Duty Value
body: Cost of Acquisition for pre-2001 asset is Higher of actual cost or FMV as on 1st April 2001.
FMV as on 1st April 2001 cannot exceed Stamp Duty Value as on 1st April 2001.

highlights.phrase: Higher of actual cost or FMV as on 1st April 2001
cannot exceed Stamp Duty Value as on 1st April 2001

points.voice_sync_text: 1st April 2001-ന് മുൻപ് വാങ്ങിയിട്ടുള്ള ഒരു capital asset ആണെങ്കിൽ, Cost of Acquisition ആയി actual cost അല്ലെങ്കിൽ 1st April 2001-ലെ Fair Market Value ഇതാണ് നമ്മൾ താരതമ്യം ചെയ്യുക. എന്നാൽ 1st April 2001-ലെ Fair Market Value ഒരിക്കലും അവിടുത്തെ Stamp Duty Value-നേക്കാൾ കൂട്ടാൻ പാടില്ല.

points.title: Investment Eligibility & CGAS Deposit Timeline
body: Investment in residential plot or house purchase or construction qualifies for Section 54 exemption.
Unutilized amount deposited in Capital Gain Account Scheme before Section 139(1) return filing date is eligible for exemption.

highlights.phrase: Capital Gain Account Scheme before Section 139(1)

points.voice_sync_text: Residential house transfer ചെയ്ത് കിട്ടുന്ന Long-Term Capital Gain ഉപയോഗിച്ച് പുതിയ residential property വാങ്ങുകയോ നിർമ്മിക്കുകയോ ചെയ്യാം. Section 139(1) തീയതിക്ക് മുമ്പ് ചിലവാക്കാത്ത തുക Capital Gain Account Scheme-ൽ നിക്ഷേപിച്ചാലും Section 54 exemption ലഭിക്കും.

points.title: Maximum ₹ 10 Crore Exemption Limit
body: Maximum allowable exemption under Section 54 is capped at ₹ 10 Crores.
If total investment and CGAS deposit exceed ₹ 10 Crores, maximum exemption is restricted to ₹ 10 Crores.
points.voice_sync_text: ഇവിടെ ഏറ്റവും പ്രധാനമായി ശ്രദ്ധിക്കേണ്ട കാര്യം, Assessment Year 2024-25 മുതൽ Section 54 exemption-ന്റെ maximum limit ₹ 10 Crores ആയി ക്ലിപ്പ് ചെയ്തിട്ടുണ്ട്. അതുകൊണ്ട് ആകെ ഇൻവെസ്റ്റ്മെന്റും deposit-ഉം ₹ 10 Crores-ൽ കൂടുതൽ വന്നാലും, maximum exemption ₹ 10 Crores മാത്രമേ ലഭിക്കൂ.

concept_simulation.doctrine_topic: Capital Gains: Section 50C Tolerance, Pre-2001 Valuation & Section 54 Ceiling
statutory_assumptions: Assessee sells a long-term residential house property.
Property was originally purchased prior to 1st April 2001.
Assessee invests in a new residential plot and deposits funds in CGAS.
concept_simulation.intro_voice: ഇനി ഇത് ഒരു simple numerical walkthrough വഴി വ്യക്തമായി മനസ്സിലാക്കാം.

steps.title: Determination of Full Value of Consideration (Section 50C)
steps.voice_sync_text: ആദ്യമായി, actual sale price 15.50 Crores രൂപയും Stamp Duty Value 17 Crores രൂപയുമാണെന്ന് കരുതുക. 15.50 Crores-ന്റെ 110 percentage എന്നത് 17.05 Crores ആണ്. Stamp Duty Value ഇതിൽ കവിയാത്തതുകൊണ്ട്, actual sale price ആയ 15.50 Crores തന്നെയാണ് Full Value of Consideration.
steps.image_prompt: A modern luxury villa with a sale deed glowing under bright studio lighting, displaying digital hologram tags of Sale Price and Stamp Duty Value in 2.5D isometric view.

steps.title: Cost of Acquisition for Pre-2001 Asset (Section 55(2)(b))
steps.voice_sync_text: രണ്ടാമതായി, asset 1993-ൽ വാങ്ങിയതാണ്. Actual cost 45 Lakhs, 01.04.2001-ലെ Fair Market Value 1.20 Crores, എന്നാൽ അവിടുത്തെ Stamp Duty Value 1.02 Crores ആണെങ്കിൽ, FMV 1.02 Crores ആയി പരിമിതപ്പെടും. അതിനാൽ Cost of Acquisition 1.02 Crores ആയിരിക്കും.
steps.image_prompt: An vintage architectural blueprint from 1st April 2001 with glowing tax scales comparing Actual Cost, Fair Market Value, and Stamp Duty Value ceiling in 2.5D visual style.

steps.title: Gross Long-Term Capital Gains Calculation
steps.voice_sync_text: ഇനി Full Value of Consideration 15.50 Crores-ൽ നിന്ന് Cost of Acquisition 1.02 Crores കുറച്ചാൽ Gross Long-Term Capital Gain 14.48 Crores രൂപ എന്ന് ലഭിക്കുന്നു.
steps.image_prompt: A clean 2.5D digital display presenting the subtraction box glowing in gold neon light, showing Gross Long Term Capital Gain.

steps.title: Section 54 Statutory Exemption Cap & Net Taxable Gain
steps.voice_sync_text: Assessee പുതിയ plot വാങ്ങാനും CGAS-ൽ ഇടാനുമായി ആകെ 11 Crores ചിലവഴിച്ചാലും, Section 54 പ്രകാരം maximum exemption limit 10 Crores രൂപയിൽ നിജപ്പെടുത്തിയിരിക്കുന്നു. അതിനാൽ 14.48 Crores-ൽ നിന്ന് 10 Crores കുറച്ചാൽ Net Taxable LTCG 4.48 Crores രൂപയാകും.
steps.image_prompt: A visual barrier wall representing the statutory maximum limit of 10 Crore rupees under Section 54, with excess capital gain passing into the Taxable Gain meter in 2.5D style.

calculation_data.formula: Gross LTCG - Section 54 Exemption (Capped at ₹ 10 Cr)

ch2_q30.doctrine: House Property & Capital Gains Statutory Framework

root.title: House Property & Capital Gains Framework
root.badge: Sec 23 · Sec 24 · Sec 25A · Sec 49(1) · Sec 50C · Sec 54 · Sec 54EC
root.voice_sync_text: House Property Income compute ചെയ്യുമ്പോഴും, Capital Asset transfer ചെയ്യുമ്പോഴും ബാധകമാകുന്ന പ്രധാന statutory provisions നമുക്ക് ഈ ലെക്ചറിലൂടെ പരിശോധിക്കാം.

points.title: Determination of GAV and Municipal Taxes
body: Gross Annual Value is higher of Expected Rent and Actual Rent received or receivable.
Municipal taxes paid by the owner including arrears are deductible from Gross Annual Value.

highlights.phrase: higher of Expected Rent and Actual Rent

points.voice_sync_text: Section 23 പ്രകാരം Gross Annual Value എന്നത് Expected Rent, Actual Rent എന്നിവയിൽ ഉയർന്ന തുകയാണ്. Assessee അടച്ച കഴിഞ്ഞ വർഷങ്ങളിലെ arrears ഉൾപ്പെടെയുള്ള Municipal Taxes മുഴുവനായും GAV-ൽ നിന്ന് subtract ചെയ്യാം.

points.title: Deductions under Section 24
body: Standard deduction allowed at 30% of Net Annual Value under Section 24(a).
Interest on borrowed capital for major repairs or construction is fully deductible under Section 24(b) for let-out property.
points.voice_sync_text: Net Annual Value കണ്ടെത്തഴിഞ്ഞാൽ Section 24(a) അനുസരിച്ച് flat 30% Standard Deduction ലഭിക്കും. കൂടാതെ property repairs-ന് എടുത്ത ലോണിന്റെ Interest, Section 24(b) പ്രകാരം deduction ആയി കിട്ടും.

points.title: Taxability & Statutory Deduction for Rent Arrears
body: Arrears of rent received are taxable in the year of receipt after a statutory deduction of 30%.
Taxable irrespective of whether the assessee remains the owner of the property in the receipt year.

highlights.phrase: remains the owner of the property

points.voice_sync_text: Section 25A പ്രകാരം Arrears of rent ലഭിക്കുന്ന വര്‍ഷത്തിൽ അതിൽ നിന്നും 30% statutory deduction கழிച്ച് ബാക്കി തുക Taxable ആകും. ആ വര്‍ഷം property അസ്സസ്സീയുടെ കയ്യിൽ ഇല്ലെങ്കിലും ഈ taxability ബാധകമാണ്.

points.title: Cost of Acquisition for Gifted Capital Asset
body: Cost of acquisition for property acquired by gift is deemed as cost to the previous owner.
Period of holding includes the period for which the property was held by the previous owner.

highlights.phrase: deemed as cost to the previous owner
includes the period for which the property was held

points.voice_sync_text: Gift ആയി ലഭിച്ച property വിൽക്കുമ്പോൾ Section 49(1) അനുസരിച്ച് cost of acquisition എന്നത് previous owner വാങ്ങിയ വിലയാണ്. Holding period കണക്കാക്കുമ്പോൾ previous owner കൈവശം വെച്ച കാലയളവും കൂട്ടണം.

points.title: Full Value of Consideration under Section 50C
body: If Stamp Duty Value exceeds 110% of actual consideration, Stamp Duty Value is taken as full value of consideration.
Stamp duty charges paid by purchaser can be used to back-calculate the official Stamp Duty Value.

highlights.phrase: Stamp Duty Value is taken as full value

points.voice_sync_text: Section 50C പ്രകാരം Stamp Duty Value എന്നത് actual consideration-ന്റെ 110 percent-നേക്കാൾ കൂടുതലാണെങ്കിൽ, Stamp Duty Value തന്നെ Full Value of Consideration ആയി എടുക്കണം.

points.title: Exemption Criteria & Adjacent Flat Rule
body: Investment in residential house within 1 year before or 2 years after transfer is exempt.
Purchase of two adjacent flats modified into a single residential unit qualifies as one residential house under Section 54.

highlights.phrase: within 1 year before or 2 years after
modified into a single residential unit

points.voice_sync_text: Section 54 പ്രകാരം residential house വിറ്റ് പുതിയ residential house വാങ്ങിയാൽ LTCG Exemption ലഭിക്കും. CIT vs Ananda Basappa വിധി പ്രകാരം, രണ്ട് adjacent flats വാങ്ങി ഒറ്റ residential unit ആയി മാറ്റി ഉപയോഗിച്ചാൽ അത് ഒരു residential house ആയി കണക്കാക്കാം.

points.title: Investment Limit & Date of Payment Benchmark
body: Investment in specified long-term bonds within 6 months from transfer date is exempt up to ₹ 50 Lakhs.
Payment made within 6 months qualifies for Section 54EC exemption even if allotment occurs after 6 months.
points.voice_sync_text: Section 54EC പ്രകാരം Capital Gain സമാഹരിച്ച് 6 മാസത്തിനകം specified bonds-ൽ invest ചെയ്യണം. Hindustan Unilever വിധി പ്രകാരം, 6 മാസത്തിനകം cheque നൽകി payment നടത്തിയാൽ, allotment 6 മാസത്തിന് ശേഷമായാലും Exemption ലഭിക്കും.

concept_simulation.doctrine_topic: Multi-Provision Assessment: House Property & Capital Gains Integration
statutory_assumptions: Illustrative round values used to demonstrate Section 50C valuation, Section 54 adjacent flat benchmark, and Section 54EC bond allotment rules.
Assessee exercises option to opt out of default tax regime under Section 115BAC.
concept_simulation.intro_voice: നമുക്ക് ഈ multi-provision legal mechanics ഒരു സാങ്കൽപ്പിക ഉദാഹരണത്തിലൂടെ വ്യക്തമായി മനസ്സിലാക്കാം.

steps.title: House Property Income Net Determination
steps.voice_sync_text: ആദ്യമായി House Property head നോക്കാം. Rent received 3 Lakhs, municipal tax paid 1 Lakh. Net Annual Value 2 Lakhs. Section 24(a) 30 percent deduction കഴിഞ്ഞാൽ 1.4 Lakhs. Borrowed interest 40,000 കഴിഞ്ഞാൽ Taxable Income 1 Lakh രൂപ വരുന്നു.
steps.image_prompt: A clean 2.5D visual graphic showing a residential house property with tax icons, showing GAV calculation leading to Net Annual Value with clear deduction tags.

steps.title: Deemed Consideration Check under Section 50C
steps.voice_sync_text: ഇനി property വിൽക്കുമ്പോൾ actual sale consideration 25 Lakhs ആണ്. എന്നാൽ Stamp Duty Value 30 Lakhs ആണ്. SDV actual consideration-ന്റെ 110 percent-ൽ കൂടുതൽ ആയതിനാൽ Section 50C പ്രകാരം Full Value of Consideration 30 Lakhs രൂപ ആയി മാറുന്നു.
steps.image_prompt: A dual scale mechanism showing 25 Lakhs Actual Consideration on one side and 30 Lakhs Stamp Duty Value on the higher side, highlighting Section 50C statutory override.

calculation_data.formula: Higher of Actual Consideration or SDV (if SDV > 110% of Actual)

steps.title: Application of Section 54 & 54EC Exemptions
steps.voice_sync_text: രണ്ട് adjacent flats വാങ്ങി ഒരൊറ്റ unit ആക്കി മാറ്റിയതിന് Ananda Basappa വിധി പ്രകാരം Section 54 Exemption 15 Lakhs ലഭിക്കും. 6 മാസത്തിനുള്ളിൽ payment നടത്തിയ NHAI bonds-ന് Hindustan Unilever വിധി പ്രകാരം Section 54EC 10 Lakhs ലഭിക്കും. ആകെ Exemption 25 Lakhs.
steps.image_prompt: Architectural floor plan showing two adjacent apartments merged into one luxury flat with Section 54 approval badge, next to an NHAI bond certificate with a Section 54EC compliance seal.

steps.title: Final Total Taxable Income Synthesis
steps.voice_sync_text: Full Value 30 Lakhs-ൽ നിന്ന് Previous Owner Cost 1 Lakh കുറച്ചാൽ LTCG 29 Lakhs. Exemption 25 Lakhs കുറച്ചാൽ Net LTCG 4 Lakhs. House Property Income 1 Lakh കൂട്ടുമ്പോൾ Total Taxable Income 5 Lakhs ലെവലിലേക്ക് എത്തിച്ചേരുന്നു.
steps.image_prompt: A modern executive tax summary board integrating House Property Income and Long-Term Capital Gains into a final Taxable Income output.

calculation_data.formula: House Property Income + Net Capital Gains

ch2_q31.doctrine: Taxation of Mutual Funds Capital Gains & Section 54F Exemption Framework

root.title: Mutual Funds Taxation & Section 54F
root.voice_sync_text: Mutual fund redemptions-ൽ Capital Gains tax apply ആകുന്നത് fund-ന്റെ nature, holding period, കൂടാതെ Section 50AA, Section 54F എന്നിവയുടെ statutory provisions അടിസ്ഥാനമാക്കിയാണ്.

points.title: Holding Period & Taxability
body: Equity oriented funds invest at least 65 percent in equity shares of domestic companies.
If held for more than 12 months, it is a Long-Term Capital Asset taxable under Section 112A.
points.voice_sync_text: Domestic companies-ന്റെ equity shares-ൽ at least 65 percent invest ചെയ്യുന്ന funds-നെയാണ് Equity Oriented Funds എന്ന് വിളിക്കുന്നത്. ഇവ 12 months-ൽ കൂടുതൽ hold ചെയ്താൽ Long-Term Capital Asset ആയി മാറും.

points.title: Deemed Short-Term Treatment
body: Specified mutual funds invest not more than 35 percent in domestic equity shares.
If acquired on or after 1st April 2023, gains are treated as deemed short-term capital gains.
points.voice_sync_text: Domestic equity shares-ൽ 35 percent-ൽ കൂടുതൽ investment ഇല്ലാത്ത Specified Mutual Funds 1st April 2023-ന് ശേഷമാണ് acquire ചെയ്തതെങ്കിൽ, holding period എന്തുതന്നെയായാലും Section 50AA പ്രകാരം deemed short-term capital gains ആയിരിക്കും.

points.title: Grandfathered Debt Funds
body: Debt funds acquired before 1st April 2023 are excluded from Section 50AA.
Holding period exceeding threshold classifies the gain as long-term capital gain.
points.voice_sync_text: 1st April 2023-ന് മുമ്പ് acquired ചെയ്ത Debt Mutual Funds-ന് Section 50AA ബാധകമല്ല. അതിനാൽ, ആവശ്യമായ holding period പൂർത്തിയാക്കിയിട്ടുണ്ടെങ്കിൽ അവ Long-Term Capital Gains ആയി തന്നെ കണക്കാക്കും.

points.title: Proportional Exemption Mechanism
body: Exemption under Section 54F is available exclusively against long-term capital gains.
Calculated proportionately using formula cost of new house divided by net consideration.

highlights.phrase: cost of new house divided by net consideration

points.voice_sync_text: Section 54F exemption ലഭിക്കുന്നത് Long-Term Capital Gains-ന് മാത്രമാണ്. Short-Term Capital Gains-ന് ഇത് ലഭിക്കില്ല. Exemption തുക, Cost of New House divided by Net Consideration എന്ന proportion-ൽ ആണ് calculate ചെയ്യുന്നത്.

concept_simulation.doctrine_topic: Mutual Fund Capital Gains & Section 54F Allocation
statutory_assumptions: Assessee redeems multiple mutual fund units and invests in a residential house.
Illustrative figures demonstrate Section 50AA applicability and Section 54F proportional exemption.
concept_simulation.intro_voice: ഇനി ഈ statutory principles ഒരു simple example വഴി മനസ്സിലാക്കാം.

steps.title: Specified Debt Fund Acquired Post 01.04.2023
steps.voice_sync_text: ഒരു assessee 1st April 2023-ന് ശേഷം acquire ചെയ്ത debt fund redeem ചെയ്യുമ്പോൾ, Section 50AA പ്രകാരം അത് deemed Short-Term Capital Gain ആയി മാറുന്നു.
steps.image_prompt: A clean 2.5D isometric representation of a digital financial document labeled Section 50AA, showing a red tag for Short-Term Capital Gain on debt investments, soft studio lighting, high resolution 16:9 frame.

steps.title: Legacy Debt Fund & Equity Fund Redemption
steps.voice_sync_text: മറ്റു രണ്ട് funds 1st April 2023-ന് മുമ്പ് വാങ്ങി long term hold ചെയ്തതുകൊണ്ട്, അവയിൽ നിന്ന് ₹ 30 Lakhs Long-Term Capital Gains ഉണ്ടാകുന്നു.
steps.image_prompt: An isometric visual showing two financial fund cards converting into green Long-Term Capital Gain tags on a sleek modern glass surface, illuminated financial dashboard context.

steps.title: Investment in New Residential House u/s 54F
steps.voice_sync_text: ഈ net consideration തുക ഉപയോഗിച്ച് ഒരു residential house വാങ്ങുമ്പോൾ, Section 54F പ്രകാരം exemption claim ചെയ്യാം.
steps.image_prompt: Architectural rendering of a modern luxury residential villa in isometric view, wrapped with glowing blue statutory checkmarks representing Section 54F compliance.

steps.title: Proportional Exemption Computation
steps.voice_sync_text: Section 54F proportional formula apply ചെയ്യുമ്പോൾ, eligible LTCG യിൽ നിന്ന് exemption കുറച്ച് ബാക്കി തുക മാത്രം taxable LTCG ആയി മാറുന്നു.
steps.image_prompt: An isometric taxation calculation screen displaying mathematical steps showing Section 54F deduction formula with final taxable capital gains output.

slides.title: Classification Matrix of Mutual Funds
slides.subtitle: Equity vs Debt Exposure Rules
slides.voice_sync_text: Mutual Funds-ന്റെ capital gain tax treatment പ്രധാനമായും fund-ന്റെ equity percentage-നെയും holding period-നെയും ആശ്രയിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു.

cards.heading: Equity Oriented Mutual Funds
points: Holding period > 12 months is classified as Long-Term Capital Asset.
Holding period ≤ 12 months is classified as Short-Term Capital Asset.

cards.heading: Debt Oriented Mutual Funds
points: Acquired before 1st April 2023: Follows standard period of holding tests.
Acquired on/after 1st April 2023: Governed by Section 50AA.

slides.title: Section 50AA: Specified Mutual Funds Rule
slides.subtitle: Mandatory Deemed Short-Term Treatment
slides.voice_sync_text: 1st April 2023-ന് ശേഷം acquire ചെയ്ത 35 percent-ൽ താഴെ equity ഉള്ള Specified Mutual Funds എപ്പോഴും deemed short-term assets ആണ്.

cards.heading: Statutory Triggers u/s 50AA
points: Investment in equity shares of domestic companies is NOT more than 35 percent.
Acquisition must be on or after 1st April 2023.
Gains are deemed to be Short-Term Capital Gains irrespective of holding duration.

slides.title: Section 54F Proportional Exemption Mechanics
slides.subtitle: Investment in Residential Property
slides.voice_sync_text: Section 54F exemption ലഭിക്കുന്നത് Long-Term Capital Gains-ന് മാത്രമാണ്. Exemption proportional formula വഴിയാണ് determine ചെയ്യുന്നത്.

cards.heading: Eligibility & Formula
points: Applies only to Long-Term Capital Assets other than a residential house.
Must invest in 1 residential house in India within statutory timeframe.
Exemption Formula: LTCG × (Cost of New House / Net Sale Consideration).

beats.headline: Mutual Funds Taxation & Section 54F Exemption
beats.subtext: Equity Exposure, Acquisition Date & Capital Gains Allocation
beats.voice_sync_text: Mutual fund redemptions-ലെ Capital Gains calculation-ഉം Section 54F exemption-ഉം എങ്ങനെ പ്രവർത്തിക്കുന്നു എന്ന് നോക്കാം.

beats.headline: Section 50AA: Deemed Short-Term Treatment
beats.voice_sync_text: 1st April 2023-ന് ശേഷം acquire ചെയ്ത 35 percent-ൽ താഴെ equity ഉള്ള funds Section 50AA പ്രകാരം deemed short-term capital assets ആണ്.

beats.headline: Section 54F Exemption Restriction
beats.subtext: STCG & Sec 50AA gains are EXCLUDED from exemption
beats.voice_sync_text: ശ്രദ്ധിക്കുക! Section 54F exemption Long-Term Capital Gains-ന് മാത്രമേ ലഭിക്കൂ. Short-Term Capital Gains-ന് ഇതിന്റെ benefit ലഭിക്കില്ല.

root.title: Section 112A & Grandfathering Valuation
root.voice_sync_text: Section 112A പ്രകാരം Long Term Capital Asset-കളുടെ Transfer-ൽ വരുന്ന Capital Gains Tax Rules-ഉം, 1st February 2018-ന് മുമ്പ് വാങ്ങിയ Assets-ന്റെ Grandfathering Cost of Acquisition-ഉം നമുക്ക് വിശദമായി പഠിക്കാം.

points.title: Tax Rate and Threshold
body: Taxable at 12.5% on Long Term Capital Gains exceeding ₹ 1,25,000 in a Financial Year.
Applicable to listed equity shares and units of equity-oriented funds subject to STT payment conditions.

highlights.phrase: 12.5% on Long Term Capital Gains exceeding ₹ 1,25,000
units of equity-oriented funds subject to STT payment conditions

points.voice_sync_text: Section 112A അനുസരിച്ച്, ഒരു Financial Year-ൽ ₹ 1,25,000-ന് മുകളിലുള്ള Long Term Capital Gains-ന് 12.5% ആണ് Tax Rate. Equity shares-നും Equity Oriented Fund units-നും STT payment conditions ബാധകമാണ്.

points.title: Cost of Acquisition Computation
body: Cost of Acquisition is Higher of Actual Cost OR Lower of FMV on 31st January 2018 and Full Value of Consideration.
This grandfathering formula protects capital gains accrued prior to 1st February 2018 from tax.

highlights.phrase: Higher of Actual Cost OR Lower of FMV on 31st January 2018 and Full Value of Consideration
protects capital gains accrued prior to 1st February 2018

points.voice_sync_text: 1st February 2018-ന് മുമ്പ് അക്വയർ ചെയ്ത Assets-ന്റെ Cost of Acquisition കണ്ടുപിടിക്കാൻ Grandfathering Formula ഉപയോഗിക്കുന്നു. Actual Cost അല്ലെങ്കിൽ FMV on 31st January 2018 and Sale Consideration-ലെ Lower Amount - ഇവയിൽ ഏതാണോ Higher, അതാണ് Cost of Acquisition.

points.title: Listed vs Unlisted Asset FMV
body: For assets listed on 31st January 2018, FMV is the highest trading price quoted on a recognized stock exchange on that date.
For unlisted units or assets not listed on 31st January 2018, FMV is the Net Asset Value (NAV) as on 31st January 2018.

highlights.phrase: highest trading price quoted on a recognized stock exchange
Net Asset Value (NAV) as on 31st January 2018

points.voice_sync_text: 31st January 2018-ൽ Listed ആയ Assets-ന് stock exchange-ലെ Highest Trading Price ആണ് FMV. എന്നാൽ 31st January 2018-ൽ Unlisted ആയ Units-ന് 31st January 2018-ലെ Net Asset Value അതായത് NAV ആണ് FMV ആയി എടുക്കേണ്ടത്.

statutory_assumptions: Asset acquired prior to 1st February 2018
STT paid at time of transfer as per Section 112A requirements
Exemption threshold of ₹ 1,25,000 applies to total LTCG
concept_simulation.intro_voice: ഇനി ഒരു simple numerical illustration വഴി Grandfathering mechanism വ്യക്തമായി മനസ്സിലാക്കാം.

steps.voice_sync_text: 1st February 2018-ന് മുമ്പ് ₹ 1,00,000 രൂപയ്ക്ക് Asset വാങ്ങിയെന്ന് കരുതുക. ഇത് നമ്മുടെ Actual Cost ആണ്.
steps.image_prompt: A modern clean corporate financial office setting showing an investor stock purchase confirmation slip dated in 2017 with clear text overlay 'Actual Cost: ₹ 1,00,000', 2.5D isometric view, cinematic lighting.

steps.title: Fair Market Value Benchmark
steps.voice_sync_text: 31st January 2018-ൽ ഈ Asset-ന്റെ Stock Exchange Highest Price അല്ലെങ്കിൽ Net Asset Value ₹ 2,50,000 ആയിരുന്നു.
steps.image_prompt: Stock exchange trading terminal monitor glowing with market charts dated 31st January 2018 displaying highest trading benchmark 'FMV: ₹ 2,50,000', photorealistic 2.5D isometric view.

slides.title: Core Tax Framework u/s 112A
slides.subtitle: Scope, Rate, and Exemption Threshold
slides.voice_sync_text: Section 112A പ്രകാരം Specified Financial Assets-ന്റെ Long Term Capital Gains-ന് 12.5% Tax Rate ആണ് ബാധകം. ആകെ LTCG-യിൽ ആദ്യത്തെ ₹ 1,25,000 രൂപ തികച്ചും Exempted ആണ്.

cards.heading: Applicable Tax Rate
points: Taxed at concessional rate of 12.5% plus applicable Health and Education Cess.
No indexation benefit allowed under the proviso to Section 48.

cards.heading: Exemption Threshold
points: Aggregate LTCG under Section 112A up to ₹ 1,25,000 per financial year is exempt.
Tax is payable exclusively on the amount exceeding ₹ 1,25,000.

dt-c1-q1.context_pill: Section 4 & 28: Diversion vs Application of Income

beats.voice_sync_text: Nammude assessee Mr. Bhargava, Supreme Court-il oru company-kku vendi appear cheyyan ₹ 5,00,000 fee negotiate cheythu. Pakshe condition: ee amount ayal create cheyyunna oru public charitable trust-ilekku povanam. Section 4 charging principles prakaram ithu Diversion of Income aano atho mere Application of Income aano?

quote_box.statute: Section 4 vs Section 28(i) of Income-tax Act, 1961
quote_box.text: Whether professional fees received subject to a self-imposed obligation to transfer the funds to a charitable trust constitutes Diversion by Overriding Title or taxable Application of Professional Income?
quote_box.highlight: Diversion by Overriding Title or taxable Application of Professional Income

beats.voice_sync_text: Ivide legal characterization check cheyyan Income Tax-il randu paths und. Superior legal title vazhi income assessee-kku kittunnathinu mumbey divert aayal ath Diversion of Income aanu, non-taxable. Ennal income assess-kku reach cheytha sesham, assessee-yude voluntary act vazhi mathram transfer cheythal ath Application of Income aayi maarum.

Landmark precedent Supreme Court-inte CIT v. Sitaldas Tirathdas aanu. Ee judgment-il Supreme Court theerth paranju: Income source-il ninnum assessee-yude adukkal ethunnathinu mumbey legal title vazhi divert cheythal mathrame exclusion kittu. Bhargava-yude case-il, client alla trust create cheythathu, client-inu obligation onnum illayirunnu. Obligation create cheythathu Mr. Bhargava thanneyanu.

ratio_box.verdict: Does the amount reach the assessee first as his own income and then applied? If yes, it is an Application of Income. A self-imposed obligation by the recipient does NOT create an overriding title.

beats.voice_sync_text: Ini namukk Mr. Bhargava-yude Assessment Year computation nokkam. Company nalkiya ₹ 5,00,000 ayalude Professional Receipts aanu. Ayal trust execute cheythu transfer cheythathu mere post-receipt application mathramayanu. So full ₹ 5,00,000 PGBP head-il assessable aakum.

ledger_rows.desc: Less: Claim of Diversion by Overriding Title

beats.voice_sync_text: CA Final exam point of view-il ee 3 Golden Rules eppozhum orkuka. Rule 1: Source of obligation check cheyyuka. Rule 2: Stage of interception examine cheyyuka. Rule 3: Self-imposed trusts are always Application of Income, taxable under PGBP.

rules.exp: Overriding title exists only if an external superior law, court decree, or payer creates the obligation before income reaches the assessee.
Diversion occurs at the source (interception). Applying funds after earning title or receipt is mere destination (application).
A professional directing clients to pay fees into their own trust is fully taxable under Section 28 as PGBP; Chapter VI-A (Section 80G) can only be explored separately.

beats.voice_sync_text: Ippo Section 54G Sub-section (1)-inte statutory mandate nokku. Statute clear aayi parayunnu: Capital Gain arise cheyyunnath transfer of Plant, Machinery, Land or Building used for industrial undertaking in an urban area aayirikkanam. And conditions fill cheyyan assesse new plant, machinery, land or building acquire cheyyendath 1 Year before OR 3 Years after the date of transfer aanu. Apex Engineering Ltd March 2026-il asset sell cheythu, July 2026-il new assets buy cheythu. This is well within the 3-year statutory window!

quote.text: Where the capital gain arises from the transfer of a capital asset, being plant, machinery, land or building... used for the purpose of an industrial undertaking situated in an urban area... and the assessee has within a period of one year before or three years after the date on which the transfer took place purchased new machinery or plant or acquired building or land...
quote.emphasis: plant, machinery, land or building... 1 year before or 3 years after

beats.voice_sync_text: Next step, Apex Engineering Ltd buy cheytha new assets-inte Eligible Reinvestment Pool calculate cheyyam. New Land: Rs 5 Lakhs, New Building: Rs 8 Lakhs, New Plant & Machinery: Rs 16 Lakhs. Total eligible investment u/s 54G is Rs 29 Lakhs! Ennal new Furniture-il invest cheytha Rs 3 Lakhs completely exclude cheyyanam. Deemed Short-term Capital Gain u/s 50 target ceiling Rs 25 Lakhs aayathukond, ee Rs 29 Lakhs exemption completely cover cheyyan mathiyaayathaanu!

outcome.text: Eligible to Set-off against both STCG & LTCG

beats.voice_sync_text: Ippo Golden Optimization Trick manassilaakku! Income-tax Act-il Section 54G exemption pro-rata set-off cheyyanam ennu niyamam illa. Assessee-kku most beneficial manner-il set-off cheyyam. Short-term Capital Gain normal slab rate-il 30% tax aayapol, Land LTCG Section 112 prakaram 12.5% tax aanu. So, Section 54G exemption of Rs 29 Lakhs-il ninnu aadyam Rs 25 Lakhs Short-term Capital Gain fully wipe out cheyyanam! Net STCG on industrial assets becomes Nil! Balance Rs 4 Lakhs exemption Land-inte Rs 5 Lakhs LTCG-yude ethire set-off cheyyanam. Balance Taxable LTCG is Rs 1 Lakh taxable @ 12.5%. Plus, Furniture STCG of Rs 1 Lakh is fully taxable. Total Taxable Capital Gain is Rs 2 Lakhs!
